tagline: Interactive AI spec discovery interviews compiling deterministic 4-file bundles with MCP integration.
bestFor: Spec discovery interviews & MCP-anchored AI agent workflows
keyFeatures: Interactive AI architect discovery interview asking targeted clarifying questions to extract full functional and non-functional requirements
Compiles deterministic 4-file specification bundles: constitution.md, requirements.md, solution.md, and tasks.md
Visual architecture diagram generation (Mermaid.js) rendered directly in the spec
Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (@myspec/mcp-server) serving structured spec context to Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and Windsurf
Free forever tier for individual developers with unlimited spec creation without credit card requirement
limitations: Hosted web studio required for initial interactive discovery interview before exporting bundles or connecting MCP
Core platform is proprietary SaaS rather than fully local open source
No built-in git worktree orchestration (leaves git branch and worktree management to IDE/developer)
Spec modifications primarily driven through web studio re-interview rather than in-terminal CLI patch deltas
